ValidationRule.description: This is to ensure we capture more information when 'Unacceptable risk' Call Outcome option is selected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISBLANK(Description), $User.Username <> "integration@admiral.com",
OR( ISPICKVAL( Call_Outcome__c , "Unacceptable risk"),
ISPICKVAL( Call_Outcome__c , "Unacceptable risk - transferred"))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide more detail for this Call Outcome
